provenance.concepts: Union of primary_concept and five graph-array fields of all 368 restored question records.
provenance.aliases: Canonical slugs, mechanical underscore-to-space spellings, explicit recovered-report spellings and exact-match aliases from the uploaded repository.
provenance.scope: No replacement question metadata was taken from the older repository seed.

alias_normalization: Unicode NFKC; casefold; Russian yo to ye; normalize dash variants; collapse whitespace; preserve punctuation and underscores.
alias_policy: alias_map contains only globally unambiguous, unconstrained spellings. Do not flatten scoped_aliases or ambiguous_aliases into global aliases. Resolve question metadata directly by concepts.slug.
runtime_notes: Correct routing uses the structured answer_concepts already stored on the question. Do not parse the dot placeholders.
Wrong routing uses wrong_fallback and prerequisite_concepts. An unresolved or unavailable follow-up must fall back or close the branch, never block the session.
Preserve existing concept edges in the repository; this restoration does not silently generate a new concept-edge topology.
